sentences: On Tuesday I did intervals at the track: five times eight hundred metres, with a jog between each one.
Yesterday we sat down to plan the next release.
In the end I suggested we ship the smaller version first and see what the users actually do with it.
This week the plan says easy, so I keep the effort low and let the watch complain.
Hello, this is Daniel from the flat on the third floor.
I would like someone to look at it this week, please, because the temperature has dropped and my flatmate has been ill.
Every Thursday I finish work a little early and walk to the station.
The streets are already busy, and the sky is usually grey.
I think about the week: what went well, what I should have done differently, and what I still want to build.
